reason: Nobody's using it yet, and I'm not handing my bookings and driver records to a company that started last week, least of all in the middle of excursion and end-of-year season. Nearly $600 a month, even with 30% off the first year, is another big subscription on top of fuel, insurance and wages, and I'd be paying for it as a guinea pig.
objection: A brand-new outfit with no customers could fold in a year. Being able to export to Excel is fine, but I'd still be stuck rebuilding everything in some other system while I've got buses on the road.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to two or three other coach operators my size who've run it through a busy season without problems, and starting after the rush, in the quiet months.
